messages:
Maria: quick follow-up on provisional-weight decay + abuse-signal routing. want to pick concrete decay half-life and clarify where signals get applied.
Ken: yeah this has been bugging me — long half-lives make transient bursts carry penalties for too long, but short half-lives reduce effectiveness against slow abusive clients.
Shreya: current prod default is ~1h half-life. i'm leaning to adding a short local decay at edge (30s-2m) + central longer decay (10-30m).
Anders: data point: last week we saw bot bursts of ~3min that ended up with degraded client QoS for ~45min due to provisions. so 1h is too sticky for bursts.
infra-bot: incident-alert: admission-inflight spiked x2 at 2024-04-12T02:14Z, top client: tenant-8432
Maria: interface decision: keep decay logic owned by admission-service (global source of truth) but let edge run lightweight short-term heuristics to immediately shed heavy flows. central admission can override and apply longer term provisional weights.
Ken: edge quick-response makes sense for capacity, but it can't see cross-region correlated abuse. risk: double-penalty if both edge+central decrement counters independently.
Shreya: proposal to avoid double-penalty: edge emits "local-shed" signal to admission with a short TTL; admission treats local-shed as softer input and uses central provisional weights that incorporate the local-shed info rather than stacking penalties.
Anders: agreed. also need priority ordering so an edge hard-reject never gets re-enqueued by central fallback — avoid flip-flop.
Shreya: sample config sketch:
```
edge_local_decay: "30s"
central_provisional_half_life: "20m"
abuse_signal_sources: ["client_rate", "kvcache_miss_pattern", "synthetic_probe_score"]
signal_keys: ["tenant_id","route","model_id","region"]
```
Ken: telemetry req: include model_id + route in the provisional-weight events so Optimize can surface regressions tied to quantization/model changes.
Maria: ops & safety: add ordered semantics in API: local_shed -> provisional_score -> penalty_action. define actions: NOOP, SOFT_THROTTLE, HARD_REJECT.
Anders: one more safety point: decay computation should be monotonic w.r.t score inputs to avoid oscillation when clients retry rapidly. add smoothing / min-dwell of 5s between state changes.
Shreya: test plan: 1) run synthetic hammering test with bursts (30s, 3min, sustained) against staging, compare client p95 latency + penalty duration; 2) enable edge_local_decay=30s canary on 5% of regions for 48h.
Maria: action items: I'll open three tickets: (A) canary config + rollout playbook; (B) telemetry keys + schema change for provisional events; (C) admission API update doc for local_shed semantics. schedule design review for tomorrow 10am PT.
Ken: :+1: I'll add the perf harness scenario and validate SLO regression boundaries.
Anders: i'll take the API doc draft and include the ordered action semantics and dwell-time constraint.
Maria: thanks everyone. ping me on-thread if you have objections to the half-life numbers before the review. :)
